entities.summary: Corey Peters is an American former professional football player who was a nose tackle in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Kentucky Wildcats. He was selected by the Atlanta Falcons in the third round of the 2010 NFL draft, and also spent time with the Arizona Cardinals and Jacksonville Jaguars.
